title: Saved report columns and sort reset once on release day
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Scenario: You had changed the columns and sort of Sales By Representative before the release, and open it after the release.
  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Before the release was installed, you changed the columns and the sort of Sales By Representative.
  • Starting screen: the release is installed and you open Reports > Sales By Representative in the same browser, desktop width at least 1024 px.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Look at the columns and the sort.
  2. Turn a column on or off in the column selector.
  3. Change the sort.
  4. Leave the report for another page.
  5. Open Reports > Sales By Representative again.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the columns and the sort are back to the defaults, and the Sales Type column is off.
  • Step 2: the report shows your column change.
  • Step 3: the report shows your sort.
  • Step 4: the other page opens.
  • Step 5: your new choices are kept; the reset happened only once.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 11 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11269 (Story 5, Credit each side on the invoice and in Sales By Representative)

  • Release day: “Each user's saved column choices and sort on Sales By Representative reset once to the defaults.”
  • S5-R21: “The Sales Type column is off by default on screen, for every user.”
